pages.text: Builds organs from $(bold)gene sequences$().$(br2)Cost: $(bold)1 sequence + 5 solids + 80,000 life energy$(), 6 seconds.$(br)Pick a target body slot on the 3×3 panel first (green = free, yellow = selected, grey = occupied).

Organ $(bold)integrity = sequence purity − random loss (0-20)$(), setting quality:$(li)integrity 100 → tier III$(li)50-99 → tier II$(li)<50 → tier I$(br2)Higher integrity pushes adaptation toward the top of the creature group range.
